hypothesis: Kumo Large with nested residual features (set E) provides complementary upstream information beyond the raw Kumo member already in public246.
selection_before_outcome: Use all and only fully completed bags 0,1,2; skip incomplete bag3. Arithmetic probability mean matches the author's assembly.
baseline: public246 saved meta-OOF and saved full-refit test predictions, C=0.003
contrasts: Fixed 5% and 20% candidate logit additions. Matched raw-Kumo additions at the same weights are a representation control; no trained stack or weight search.
report: Overall ROC-AUC, paired fold deltas using native StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42), standalone AUC, raw candidate comparison, maximum rank correlation with existing246.
limitations: Fixed external OOF comparison is exploratory and not end-to-end nested CV.
Native split has been used for historical selection; it is not an untouched holdout.
Parts lack independent ID sidecars; row alignment depends on audited source and original row order.
Resumed parts must be traced to the source versions that produced them; same filename alone does not establish feature-setting identity.
Failure at these two weights does not rule out all weights or all Kumo representations.
